name: Can cabinet painting be included in a kitchen remodel instead of cabinet replacement?

mainEntity.name: Can cabinet painting be included in a kitchen remodel instead of cabinet replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting existing kitchen cabinets requires intensive surface preparation and specialized coatings that differ from standard wall painting. Cabinets require thorough degreasing, scuff sanding, high-adhesion bonding primer, and durable enamel coatings to withstand daily hand oils, heat, and impacts. Painting walls involves standard acrylic latex finishes over patched sheetrock. If cabinet doors are structurally sound and the layout works, refinishing them saves substantial money compared to replacing the full cabinet boxes during a kitchen update.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Cabinet painting uses durable bonding primers and enamel finishes, offering an economical update if your existing cabinet boxes and door structures are in good condition.
